reviews.text: Too early to tell, but it feels really nice on the skin. My skin looks really healthy and glowy, but the actual brightening effect is too early to tell
reviews.zh: 而家講仲言之尚早，但用喺皮膚上感覺真係好正。皮膚睇落好健康好有光澤，不過實際提亮效果仲要再睇睇。

reviews.text: This is really good for winter months and needing that extra power. It does not cause acne so perfect for acne prone skin. It’s a savior for those of us on retinoids!
reviews.zh: 冬天用真係一流，啱晒需要額外加強修護嘅時候。唔會引致爆瘡，痘痘肌必備。對我哋呢啲用緊retinoids嘅人嚟講簡直係救星！

reviews.text: Holy grail for my dehydrated skin! It makes my skin feel soft and moisturized, I’ve been using it day and night and it helps a lot. It’s not irritating at all to me, and I have sensitive skin. Would def recommend for people with dehydrated skin.
reviews.zh: 對我缺水肌嚟講簡直係神級產品！用完皮膚又軟又保濕，日夜都用，幫到手好多。我敏感肌用完全冇刺激感。強烈推薦畀缺水肌嘅人。

reviews.text: I am new to trying this product so will determine how well it is for my skin. But so far, it’s great and gentle on the skin, soft and moisturizing. May come back with future update on results :)
reviews.zh: 第一次試呢款產品，要用多啲先知啱唔啱我。但暫時用落好溫和，皮膚感覺軟熟又保濕。日後可能會再返嚟分享效果 :)

reviews.text: This works very good as serum, I’m not that sure about its benefits but I like Mixsoon so I’m sure it work good. I like the texture and how it feels.
reviews.zh: 當精華用效果好好，我唔係好確定佢嘅功效有幾多，但我鍾意Mixsoon，所以相信一定work。我鍾意佢嘅質感同觸感。

reviews.text: Meets all of its claims and as my skin health has improved I can visibly see a difference before and after use. I prefer the pads but when you're strapped for time this gets the job done
reviews.zh: 完全達到佢聲稱嘅效果，隨住皮膚健康改善，用前用後明顯見到分別。我比較鍾意化妝棉，但趕時間嘅時候用呢款一樣得。

reviews.text: It goes on a bit tacky but give it some time to absorb and it actually forms a nice base for make up. I pat my face gently to help absorption. It feels hydrating all day long.
reviews.zh: 塗上去有少少黏笠，但等佢慢慢吸收之後其實係一個好好嘅妝前底霜。我會輕輕拍打塊面幫助吸收。成日都好保濕。

reviews.text: I use this in the morning before applying makeup. It does absorb quickly and it is moisturizing. I also apply it at night after using the mixsoon essence. It doesn’t leave any irritation on my skin.
reviews.zh: 我朝早化妝前會用，吸收得快又保濕。夜晚用完mixsoon精華之後都會再用。用完皮膚完全冇刺激感。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
